properties.name: 2 The Cottage: outdoor enclosure, 16-port LC patch box

properties.name: Woods cabinet: 1U LC panel, media converter, UniFi Flex
properties.notes: Grey outdoor 19-inch cabinet on a concrete plinth next to MH12, beside a pole. Inside: a 1U LC patch panel (F04 spliced to LC 1-8, F03 to LC 36-59, our numbering), a media converter, a UniFi Flex switch and a PoE injector on a shelf, and a power strip. F04 fibres 5-8 are patched to F03 fibres 5-8; F03 fibre 3 is a 1G BiDi circuit to the barn (Nat on site, 2026-11-06).
properties.source: Nat, placed in geojson.io; on site 2026-11-06
